 US Central Command (CENTCOM) has denied a claim by Iran’s army that its air defences had fired a missile at a US F-16 fighter jet over the Gulf on Friday evening, damaging the aircraft and forcing it to land. In a statement on X, CENTCOM said: “All US fighter jets in the Middle East are safe and accounted for.”
 The Iranian navy says an oil tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine in a restricted area east of the Strait of Hormuz, while the UK maritime agency says two oil tankers were hit by “unknown projectiles” north and east of Oman’s Khasab.
